original:
在完成先期工作，各个部门都已经做好了迎接准备，希洛小姐来到了§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!享受她的休闲时光，这也是所有人翘首以盼的事情。
“那个，大家好啊，真是不好意思，让你们费这么多心思。” 
略带歉意的摸着后脑勺说，少女提着一个篮子出现在广阔的平原上。大量的飞艇在周围盘旋，大量警力被部署在周围维持秩序，并提前拉起了上百公里的警戒线，行星防卫部队也抽调了两个军团前来协助。而这些并不能阻碍居民们热情地欢呼声，为了让她能够看到，许多人打出了超大型礼花，或者使用投影设备，当然还有飞行表演喷射出显眼的彩色烟雾组成欢迎的字样。
“哇，这是给我准备的吗？谢谢，大家都好热情啊” 
看着半空中的文字，希洛开心地说。
“是个很漂亮的地方，看样子可以好好休息一会了” 
环顾四周，寻找了一块看上去比较整洁的地面，少女放下篮子，从里面取出了提前准备好的野餐垫，盖在了地面上，足以覆盖数百平方公里。
“如果你们不介意的话…….我想把鞋子脱下来” 
少女带着羞涩说，应该没有人会拒绝这样的请求吧？答案已经很明显了。于是，很自然地，我们得到了欣赏少女足部的机会。
“呼，感觉这样好像轻快了一些。阳光也很舒服，真是和平啊” 
将脱下来的皮鞋放到一边，被白丝包裹的脚掌轻盈地落在野餐垫上，然后坐了下来，双腿自然伸展，悠闲地仰望着蔚蓝的天空，从篮子里拿出一个三明治，小口品尝起来。许多的记者乘坐专用飞行器从不同角度记录下了这祥和的景象。
“哎！你们在往哪里看呢？” 
像是某种直觉，希洛小姐低下头，随后便注意到那几艘靠在她脚边的飞艇。似乎还有摄影师为了拍摄完美的足部特写不顾劝阻想要靠近，好在我们的飞行单位及时拦下了他们。
“感觉好难理解哦，你们就这么喜欢我的脚吗？” 
娇嫩地呵斥声，她的脸颊变得羞红，看着就像是在发烫一般，双脚不由自主地摆动起来，却又无可奈何。 
“不行，不能给大家添麻烦，唔，还是好好尝尝有没有可以改进的地方。” 
于是，希洛小姐只把那些记者当成不存在，用食物转移注意力，但是脸上那某红色始终没有消失。
“感觉一个人吃有点无聊，明明身边有这么多人…….” 
又咬了几口，少女表情有些枯燥，忽然眼前一亮，温和的笑容，向着民众发出邀请。
“就这样让你们在旁边看着，也有点过意不去，大家陪我一起吃好啦” 
人群之中随即发出欢呼声，甚至发生了一些混乱，人潮开始冲击起了警戒线。
“希洛小姐，请不要这样做，很危险的” 
“唔，抱歉哦，但是一个人真的很无趣哦，还是大家一起吃更开心一点” 
“好吧，但是请务必小心，不要造成更大的混乱” 
迫于她那真挚的眼神，我们只好下令缩紧封锁线，让民众可以与她更近距离接触，但依然要确保一定的安全距离，避免引发事故。
由于野餐垫实在是太高了，就像一座城墙一般，一些有条件的人已经使用飞行手段快速接近，还有些人在边缘架起了足够车辆通行的斜坡，毕竟从边缘到达她所在的位置，依然有着数公里的距离，想要徒步完成并不是一件容易的事情。
“料理还是要一起分享才更好吃，大家都来尝尝吧，是我亲手做的哦” 
甜美的声音，希洛小姐打开篮子向身旁的民众分享自己带来的美食，已经有运输队伍搬来的大量的桌椅，就仿佛是在举行一场盛大的庆典。食物的香气，甚至连临近的城市都弥漫着浓郁的香味，整个活动一直持续到午后。
“居然还剩这么多？看样子之前做太多了。” 
目光扫过自己的篮子，里面还剩下相当可观数量的巨型料理。
“就这样浪费了也不好，但是我自己也不好处理呢，嗯，那就都送给你们好了。” 
思索了片刻，少女决定将剩余的食物留给我们。
“嗯，刚好有一点灵感，那最后在送你们一件礼物…..” 
仿佛突然有了新的想法，她的心念一动，一柄华丽的剑凭空出现在手中。
“作为练习作品的话，应该还可以。” 
随意地挥舞了几下，希洛满意地点头，四处张望了一下，最后将目光落在一座山峰上，迈着轻快地步伐走了过去。
“记得阿尔托莉雅不是有一把石中剑吗？嗯，这座山看上去就不错，那就放在这里好了” 
巍峨的山峰，在她身前，也不过是一块大一点的石头。她双手握住剑，高高举起。
“嘿呀！”
伴随着一声娇喝，那把巨大的剑就这样从山巅插了进去，深深地嵌入大地。
“也许应该叫它山中剑？好像还挺有趣的，不过这里应该没有人能拔出来，希望你们会喜欢” 
于是希洛小姐在临走前还留下了大量的食物，以及一把非常巨大的剑，也许它可以成为§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!上的一个新的地标。
translation:
After completing the preliminary work, all departments were ready for the reception. Ms. Shiro arrived at §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§! to enjoy her leisure time, which was also something everyone had been eagerly awaiting.
“Um, hello everyone. I'm so sorry for making you go through all this trouble.”
With a slight apologetic scratch at the back of her head, the girl appeared on the vast plains carrying a basket. A large number of airships hovered around, and a significant police force was deployed to maintain order, with a perimeter of hundreds of kilometers set up in advance. The planetary defense forces also dispatched two legions to assist. However, these did not deter the residents' enthusiastic cheers. To ensure she could see them, many people set off massive fireworks or used projection devices, and there were also flight performances spraying conspicuous colored smoke to form welcoming words.
“Wow, is this all for me? Thank you, everyone is so warm!”
Looking at the words in the sky, Shiro said happily.
“It's a very beautiful place. It looks like I can have a good rest for a while.”
Looking around for a clean spot on the ground, the girl put down her basket and took out a pre-prepared picnic mat, spreading it over the surface, enough to cover hundreds of square kilometers.
“If you don't mind... I'd like to take off my shoes.”
The girl said with a hint of bashfulness. Surely no one would refuse such a request? The answer was already obvious. Thus, naturally, we were given the opportunity to admire the girl's feet.
“Phew, that feels a bit lighter. The sunlight is also very comfortable. It's truly peaceful.”
Setting her removed leather shoes aside, her feet, encased in white silk, landed lightly on the picnic mat. She then sat down, her legs stretching naturally as she gazed leisurely at the blue sky. Taking a sandwich from her basket, she began to taste it in small bites. Many journalists in special flight vehicles recorded this serene scene from different angles.
“Hey! Where are you looking?”
Like some kind of intuition, Shiro lowered her head and noticed several airships clustered near her feet. It seemed some photographers, in their quest for the perfect close-up of her feet, tried to approach despite warnings. Fortunately, our flight units intercepted them in time.
“It's so hard to understand... do you really like my feet that much?”
A delicate scolding, her cheeks flush with a deep red, looking as if they were burning. Her feet kicked involuntarily, yet she was helpless.
“No, I can't cause trouble for everyone. Mm, I should just focus on tasting this and see if there's anything to improve.”
Thus, Shiro chose to treat those journalists as if they didn't exist, using food to divert her attention, though the red on her face never truly faded.
“Eating alone feels a bit boring, even with so many people around...”
After a few more bites, the girl's expression turned a bit dull. Suddenly, her eyes lit up, and with a gentle smile, she extended an invitation to the public.
“Keeping you all watching from the side makes me feel a bit bad. Why don't you all join me for the picnic!”
Cheers immediately erupted from the crowd, and some chaos ensued as the throng began to press against the perimeter.
“Ms. Shiro, please don't do that. It's very dangerous.”
“Um, sorry, but eating alone is really dull. It's much more enjoyable to eat together with everyone.”
“Alright, but please be careful and don't cause any major chaos.”
Pressed by her sincere gaze, we had no choice but to order the tightening of the blockade while allowing the public to get closer to her, though a safe distance was still maintained to prevent accidents.
Since the picnic mat was so high—like a city wall—those with the means used flying vehicles to quickly approach. Others set up ramps at the edges wide enough for vehicles, as the distance from the edge to her position was still several kilometers, making it difficult to traverse on foot.
“Food is always better when shared. Come and try some, everyone; I made it myself!”
With a sweet voice, Shiro opened her basket to share the delicacies she had brought with the nearby citizens. Transport teams had already brought in a large number of tables and chairs, making it feel like a grand celebration. The aroma of the food was so strong it even filled the nearby cities. The event continued well into the afternoon.
“There's so much left? I guess I made too much earlier.”
Glancing over her basket, a considerable amount of giant-sized dishes remained.
“It's not good to let it go to waste, but I can't handle it all myself. Well, I'll just give it all to you then.”
After a moment's thought, the girl decided to leave the remaining food for us.
“Hmm, I just had a bit of inspiration. One last gift for you all...”
As if struck by a new idea, a magnificent sword appeared in her hand with a single thought.
“As a practice piece, it should be alright.”
After a few casual swings, Shiro nodded in satisfaction. Looking around, her gaze finally landed on a mountain peak, and she walked toward it with light steps.
“I remember Artoria had a Sword in the Stone, right? Hmm, this mountain looks pretty good. I'll just leave it here then.”
The towering peak was no more than a slightly larger rock before her. She gripped the sword with both hands and held it high.
“Heiyah!”
With a delicate shout, the massive sword was thrust down from the mountaintop, deeply embedding itself into the earth.
“Maybe it should be called the Sword in the Mountain? It seems quite interesting. Though probably no one here can pull it out. I hope you like it.”
Thus, before leaving, Shiro left behind a vast amount of food and an enormous sword, which might just become a new landmark on §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!.

original: 我们的法师在进行魔法实验时发生重大意外——导致一颗巨大的小行星被召唤出来，并且正在向§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!飞来！如果任由它撞击表面的话，将会造成灾难性的后果。必须尽早消灭这颗小行星！
translation: A major accident occurred while our mages were conducting magical experiments—leading to the summoning of a massive asteroid that is now hurtling toward §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!! If it is allowed to strike the surface, the consequences will be catastrophic. This asteroid must be eliminated as soon as possible!
